content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to transfer a [product_name] Web Editor project to the [product_name] device without using an SD card?
It is not possible without an SD card.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a way to directly download a project created with [product_name] Web Editor to the [product_name] device, skipping the requirement for an SD card. The reply confirms that an SD card is necessary for this process. This presents a limitation for users who do not have readily available SD cards during deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to transfer [product_name] Web Editor projects directly to the [product_name] device without needing an SD card.
